::: {#def-ffrcistg .theorem}
## FFRCISTG model

A finest fully randomized causally interpretable structured tree graph (FFRCISTG) is a causal model $\mathcal{C}=(\mathcal{M},\mathcal{M}^{(\Gamma)})$ of an NPSEM $\mathcal{M}$, where $\mathcal{M}$ satisfies (1) no contagion, (2) no interference, (3) identical structural distributions, and (4) single-world independence. The conditions are on $\mathcal{M}$, so they hold for every regime $\Gamma$; the same is true of the models below. See Remark 2.
:::
